title: PET-Lab: Condition-Aware Machine-Learning Models and Datasets for Engineering Thermostable PET-Degrading Enzymes
description: Trained models and leakage-audited datasets from the PET-Lab project: a two-model ML pipeline (ESM-2 based) for engineering thermostable PET-degrading enzymes. Includes the trained ddG mutation model, cached ESM-2 embeddings, and homology-clean pH-optimum train/test datasets (BRENDA + UniProt). Leakage standard: mmseqs2, >=30% identity / >=50% coverage, bidirectional.
